event_summary: A cream-colored fabric moves down and forward over a stationary teapot until the teapot is hidden beneath a fabric mound.
raw_event_description: At the start, a colorful teapot stands upright on a wooden tabletop in front of a cream-colored hanging fabric. After a long still interval, the fabric moves downward and toward the foreground, first covering the top of the teapot, then the body, handle, and spout. A small lower part of the teapot remains briefly visible below the fabric, then the teapot becomes fully obscured. The final view shows a cream fabric mound on the tabletop with a plain gray wall visible above it.

reasons: The teapot is fully visible and upright.
The tabletop and hanging fabric backdrop are visible.
No object motion is visible in the first frame.
